newsitem.title: UK: RTZ advances on third quarter output news.
newsitem.headline: RTZ advances on third quarter output news.

text.p: Shares in mining group RTZ Corp Plc were indicated higher on Thursday after Anglo-Australian company RTZ-CRA said that third quarter production was up on last year in almost all of its products.
The shares jumped 6-1/2p to 971-1/2p by 0710 GMT in pre-market trade shortly after the announcement.
The company said on Thursday that total copper mine output was up nine percent over last year and total refined copper output was up 48 percent on the year.
"The figures look pretty good," said Simon Beardsmore, analyst at T. Hoare & Co. "I think people will probably re-work their numbers in the light of this," he added.
Beardsmore said a 48 percent increase in refined copper production looked healthy considering that the company had run into problems getting its Utah smelter up and running.
In Chile, the Escondida Phase III expansion had increased copper output by 63 percent.
"The increase at Escondida has been coming through for some time," the analyst said. "But again it's impressive."
Beardsmore said a six percent increase in coal production in the U.S. will have offset some of the price deterioration.
Elsewhere, the company said the Greens Creek U.S. mine recorded its first production since re-opening.
"It looks as though Greens Creek has come on earlier than expected," the analyst added.
